paragraphs: From Ballincollig, begin on Classes Lake and take the 1st right to stay on Classes Lake.
Follow the road slight left and continue for about 300 metres.
Take the next right into Berryfield.
At the end of Berryfield, turn left onto Chestnut Grove and follow it for roughly 280 metres.
Take the next right into Chestnut Crescent.
Keep left as the road curves round and loop back through Chestnut Crescent.
Take a left and then a right at the end of the road to rejoin Chestnut Grove.
Follow Chestnut Grove back down and turn right onto Berryfield.
Turn left onto Classes Lake and continue for around 870 metres to the roundabout.
At the roundabout keep slight left onto the R608, then exit left and merge slight right onto the Ballincollig Bypass.
After about 770 metres, take the off ramp slight left.
Go straight through the next roundabout onto Greenfields Road via West Village.
Turn left onto Greenfield, then right onto the unnamed road near Woodberry.
Perform a controlled U-turn here for practice on reversing manoeuvres.
Come back onto Greenfield and turn left, then left again onto Greenfields Road.
Continue straight for over a kilometre as the road name changes to Castle Road and then Sunningdale.
Turn left onto Station Road, then left again into Church View.
Work your way through the estate roads in Church View, using end-of-road lefts and rights to practice observation and signalling.
Complete a U-turn where the road allows.
Retrace your way back out of Church View onto Station Road.
At the end of Station Road, turn left onto Main Street.
Follow Main Street for roughly 2.5 kilometres back toward the test centre.
Turn right onto Classes Lake.
Turn right into The Meadows, keeping right as the road bends.
Continue to finish the route back near Ballincollig test centre.
